name: cake Gobbles orange
ingredients_raw: Refined Wheat Flour (maida), Sugar, Eggs, Hydrogenated Vegetable Oil & Refined Palmolein Oil, Fruit Products(9%)(glazed Papaya Cuts & Orange Pulp), Humectant [422 & 420(ii)], High Maltose Syrup, Edible Maize Starch, Penta Cake{raising Agents [450(i) 500(ii), 341(i) & 341(iii)], Emulsifiers(472e, 466 & 435), Stabilizer (412) & Acidity Regulator(330)}, Cake Gel { Emulsifiers & Stabilizers(471 & 477) And Humectand[420(ii)]}, Iodised Salt, Raising Agents [341(i), 450(i) 500(ii)], Nature-identical (orange) And Artificial (vannila) Flavouring Substances, Invert Sugar Syrup, Preservatives(202 & 282), Emulsifiers(435), Colour(110 & 122), Acidity Regulator(330) And Stabilizer (415).
